<!DOCTYPE html>
        
            

                
                
                Mezze Cashier
                
                var odoo = {debug: ""};
                
                
                    
                    (function(){try{
                        var h=document.documentElement, p=new URLSearchParams(location.search);
                        var o={}; try{o=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('mzSettings.v1')||'{}')||{};}catch(e){}
                        var mode=p.get('mzmode')||o.app_mode||'system';
                        if(mode==='system')mode=(window.matchMedia&&window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches)?'dark':'light';
                        var hc=(p.get('mztheme')==='highcontrast')||!!o.ac_contrast;
                        h.setAttribute('data-theme',mode);
                        h.setAttribute('data-mz-mode',mode);
                        h.setAttribute('data-mz-theme',hc?'highcontrast':(mode==='dark'?(o.app_dark_theme||'lounge'):(o.app_theme||'classic')));
                        h.setAttribute('data-mz-accent',p.get('mzaccent')||o.app_accent||'terracotta');
                    }catch(e){}})();
